caption: The drawing features two depictions of a horse-shaped object, both rendered in shades of gray. The larger, more detailed horse dominates the image, oriented toward the left, with its front legs raised and flexed as if in motion. The horse has a muscular build with defined contours and shading, and a tail sweeping to the right. A yellow-golden ring, attached to the horse’s back via a short vertical post, resembles a loop for hanging or attaching the object, possibly suggesting it is a pendant or ornament. The mane and tail are highlighted with streaks of yellow-green along the top. Below and to the right of the large horse is a much smaller, simplified version of the same horse-and-ring object, rendered in similar gray with less detail. The background is plain and light-colored, with minor marks and a small red smudge to the right.
title: Horse Watch Fob
